contract.classification: synthetic dimensionless software test of blind integer timing recovery; no physical validity claimed
contract.protocol_status: v6 exploratory protocol; conditions frozen in source and committed before the full run; not a formal preregistration or physical validation
contract.preservation: hash-locked v1-v5 modules are imported and used unchanged; every estimate uses decode_wave

seed_streams.random_vectors: SeedSequence([master_seed, 3, distribution_index, offset_index]); per batch the frame vectors are drawn first, then the noise

pass_rules.abs_error_le_0.25: inclusive: all 32 absolute component errors <= 0.25 (the v2-v5 rule)
pass_rules.round_to_integer_exact: integer-alphabet panel only: numpy.round (half-to-even) of every estimate equals the transmitted integer

contract.receiver_buffer_model: y[m] = S(m - 64 + Delta) + noise[m] for m = 0..2175, S the continuous p.12 frame signal (zero outside the 32 symbols); positive Delta = receiver late (v5 convention). For integer Delta, y is built from the unchanged encoder and equals the v5 nominal stream; IID Gaussian noise on every buffer sample, guards included

methods.existing_nominal_decoder: unchanged decode_wave on windows at 64 + 64k (no correction); identical to the v5 nominal decoder
methods.oracle_exact_timing: analysis-only upper bound told the exact integer offset; windows at 64 + 64k - Delta
methods.oracle_best_integer_timing: fractional panel: analysis-only reference told Delta; uses whichever of -floor(Delta) and -ceil(Delta) has the higher pooled analytic pass probability at SD 0.45 (the best a perfect integer-only search can do on average)
methods.blind_matched_filter_energy_search: blind: for each candidate c in -16..16 decode all 32 windows at 64 + 64k + c with decode_wave and choose c maximising sum_k estimate_k^2; ties resolve to smallest |c| then smallest c; never told the offset; uses the known frame length, symbol length and carrier phase reference
methods.blind_raw_frame_energy_search: blind: choose c maximising the received energy in samples [64 + c, 64 + c + 2048) (frame-energy detection against noise-only guards); same tie rule; then decode_wave

contract.timing_acquisition_definition: integer panels: chosen correction == -Delta exactly; fractional panel: chosen correction == the best-integer oracle's correction
contract.paired_comparisons: methods share every noisy buffer; discordant counts and exact two-sided McNemar (binomial) p-values on pooled frames
contract.analytic_calibration: theory = product over 32 windows of P(|Normal(bias_k, sigma/sqrt(32))| <= 0.25) with bias_k from the clean buffer (unchanged v5 function); pooled = equal-vector mean; random panel theory reported for the oracle only
contract.why_easy_here: noise-only zero guards, known frame and symbol length, integer offsets, constant offset, no clock drift, no CFO, carrier locked to the sample clock, IID Gaussian noise
